summary: Build governed, reusable data products with data mesh, quality rules, contracts, and service levels. Explore practical training for mature data teams.
lede: Data product management helps data and analytics teams turn fragmented data into governed, reusable products. It covers data mesh domains and federated ownership, consumer discovery, data contracts, quality rules, metadata and lineage, and service-level measures. Learners practice creating product canvases, governance controls, and implementation roadmaps.
audienceIntro: Data Product Management is most useful for professionals responsible for turning fragmented organisational data into governed, reusable products. This course is designed for advanced data and digital transformation teams that need practical ownership, quality, delivery, and consumer-management methods.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience with organisational data, analytics delivery, reporting operations, or data governance. Familiarity with SQL, data pipelines, metadata, and enterprise reporting will help, but advanced programming is not required. Completion uses structured exercises and configuration examples rather than production deployment. Advanced topics such as federated computational governance and AI-assisted data quality are taught at operational application and conceptual awareness levels.
